commits.subject: feat: add TTL cache for token lookups

session_excerpt:
U: login is slow, every request hits the auth API
A: I chose an in-process TTL cache over Redis: there is a single instance and no shared state, so Redis would add a service to run for no gain. Gotcha found: tokens must be evicted on logout, otherwise a logged-out token stays valid until the TTL expires. Fixed by calling cache.invalidate(token) in logout().
U: also fix the README typo
